subject: CAIQ evidence triage + platform gap log for Greenline Health
messages:
From: Paul Kramer <paul.kramer@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Greenline Health Security <security@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ mapping kickoff and evidence ask

Karthik,

Thanks again for walking us through Redwood's footprint yesterday. Our compliance team asked for a first-pass CAIQ mapping and an itemized list of evidence artifacts we can expect to receive so we can triage on our side. Specifically:

- A mapping that links each CAIQ question to Redwood's control owner and evidence artifact name (spreadsheet preferred).
- A short gap log for anything that is partial / in-progress.
- Network diagram and dataflow snapshot for the platform components that handle PHI.

Can you confirm: timeline to get a draft mapping, the likely owners we'll need to loop in, and whether you can provide any pre-packaged evidence (S3 links / DocuSign / SOC2 pointer)?

Attachments: [attachment: caiq_request.pdf (application/pdf)]

Best,
Paul
Paul Kramer
Director, Security & Compliance
Greenline Health
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Paul Kramer <paul.kramer@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 12:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping kickoff and evidence ask

Paul — thanks for the clear asks. Quick plan below: 

1) Draft CAIQ mapping (spreadsheet): Karthik will own the initial crosswalk; expect first draft in 3 business days (Thu 10 Jun).
2) Evidence index: Mina will assemble existing artifacts (SOC 2 package, key config screenshots, audit log extracts) and flag anything that needs a new export.
3) Gap log + remediation notes: Laura will own compiling items flagged as partial or missing and propose mitigations.
4) Network diagram/dataflow: We have a recent VPC diagram; will attach the PNG and note which subnets touch customer data.

We can supply file links to a secure Drive folder and generate pre-signed S3 URLs for large artifacts. If you need an encrypted transfer or HSM-signed manifests, we can coordinate with your security ops.

Will also attach a lightweight \"triage spreadsheet\" that shows CAIQ question id, Redwood control mapping, owner, evidence filename, and status (complete / partial / missing).

Attachments: [attachment: caiq-mapping-sheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)], [attachment: network-architecture-diagram.png (image/png)]

Next steps: I will drop the draft mapping to the Drive link below when ready and loop in any engineering owners for technical evidence exports. If Greenline wants a short walkthrough of the mapping, we can set a 30-min session next week.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Paul Kramer <paul.kramer@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping kickoff and evidence ask — draft index attached

Karthik / Laura / Paul — attaching the first-pass evidence index and an initial platform gap log. Highlights:

- Evidence index (tabbed): SOC2-report-2026.pdf reference; audit_log_sample_202705.csv (redacted) available; KMS key rotation policy screenshot (IAM console).
- Platform gap log (CSV): 6 items currently partial (audit retention window for streaming cache, formalized data retention SLA for embeddings, automated export for KMS audit events). Each item has proposed owner and ETA.
- Note: PHI-bearing ingestion path lives in a restricted subnet; export of raw ingestion payloads requires a controlled request to our infra team (owner: Marcus Lin).

I marked items that will require engineering tickets. If Greenline needs tighter retention windows, we can propose configuration changes and impact notes.

Attachments: [attachment: platform-gap-log.csv (text/csv)], [attachment: evidence-index.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Manager, Customer Security Operations
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
From: Paul Kramer <paul.kramer@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping kickoff and evidence ask — draft index attached

Thanks Karthik / Mina — this is helpful and shows good coverage. A couple quick follow-ups before we proceed to formal review:

- Can you add a column that calls out whether an artifact contains PHI or PII (yes/no) so our legal/compliance reviewers can triage?
- For the three partial items in the gap log, can you provide a short expected delivery date and whether a configuration change is required?
- Please confirm if the SOC2 package includes the most recent monitoring playbook; I couldn't find it in evidence-index.docx.

If you can get those edits in by Monday EOD our security reviewers will start the formal assessment. Also please drop the Drive folder link with the pre-signed artifacts when ready.

On the walkthrough — a 30-min slot on Tue 14 Jun 2027 would work for our team.

Best,
Paul
Paul Kramer
Director, Security & Compliance
Greenline Health
